theme: Studio Dark Vibe (High-Contrast, Tactile Creative Studio)
context_type: Mobile-First Hybrid Fullstack App (Studio Character Design Tool)

typography.heading_font: Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Syne, sans-serif (Prohibited: Inter for headlines)
typography.body_font: Manrope or Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono, monospace (for Prompt String Preview, DNA JSON, and ComfyUI logs)

scale.section_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-mono text-amber-500/90 font-bold
scale.caption: text-xs text-zinc-400 font-medium

layout_and_grids.mobile: Single column mobile-first with sticky bottom navigation or drawer, bottom sheet trait selection, swipeable horizontal chips, thumb-friendly tap targets (min 44px).
layout_and_grids.desktop: Three-pane studio desktop layout: Pane 1 Left Nav/Sections Sidebar (w-64) | Pane 2 Center DNA Form Builder (flex-1 scrollable) | Pane 3 Right Live Preview Panel + Prompt String Panel + Render Status & Gallery Drawer (w-96 or w-[420px]).
layout_and_grids.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: p-4 to p-6 inside card containers; gap-4 to gap-6 between grid widgets; strict border padding to avoid text collisions.

sections_breakdown: Physique (Height, Body Type, Muscularity, Curves, Bust/Chest, Proportions)
Face (Eye Shape, Eye Color, Jawline, Nose, Lips, Expression, Age Detail)
Hair (Style, Length, Color, Texture, Bangs, Facial Hair)
Skin (Tone, Texture, Freckles, Tattoos, Tan Lines, Oiliness/Glow, Imperfections)
Wardrobe (Top, Bottom, Lingerie/Underwear, Material, Color Palette, Fit)
Pose (Action, Angle, Camera Distance, Hand Placement, Body Language)
Lighting (Source, Color Temperature, Direction, Cinematic Style, Mood)
Camera (Lens Focal Length, Aperture/Depth of Field, Angle, Aspect Ratio)
Style (Realistic Photography, Cinematic, Analog Film Grain, Octane Render, NSFW/Artistic Tone)

visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle 1px border (#222634), deep background (#12141C), rounded-xl, hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all
visual_enhancers.chip_buttons: Tactile pill buttons with dark borders, active state highlighted in Amber (#F59E0B) or Emerald (#10B981) with soft glow shadow
visual_enhancers.bottom_sheets: Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80), smooth spring slide up, rounded-t-2xl with grab handle
visual_enhancers.prompt_preview: Monospace editor card with syntax-highlighted tokens, copy-to-clipboard, lock toggle per section, live character count
visual_enhancers.progress_bar: WebSocket render progress bar with glowing amber/cyan accent, percentage indicator, frame time, and live step logs

character_previews.description: Dramatic red and dark cinematic portrait lighting

testing_attributes.mandate: Every interactive element (button, slider, input, tab, card, chip, dropdown, modal trigger, WebSocket state widget) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React js (.js / .jsx), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide-React icons, Sonner for notifications.
core_workflows: 1. Build DNA Form with 11 distinct sections, slider controls, chip sets, searchable dropdowns, lock/randomize per section.
2. Prompt Builder engine that dynamically parses DNA state into standard SDXL/FLUX positive and negative prompt strings with real-time editing.
3. AI Assist integration: OpenRouter API freeform-to-DNA parser, refine prompt mode, and per-section AI trait suggestions.
4. ComfyUI Local Server integration: Dispatch generation jobs, track status with WebSocket mock/live handler, view progress bar & live generated output.
5. Character Library: Save character DNA snapshots, versioning, tag filter, search, duplicate, favorite, export/import JSON.
6. Render Gallery: Display generated outputs linked to character DNA snapshots with full prompt viewer and metadata modal.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure dark studio vibe theme with rich obsidian (#090A0F) and dark slate (#12141C) surfaces.
Never use generic centered layouts or AI purple gradients.
Use distinct font pairings (Outfit for headers, Manrope for body, JetBrains Mono for prompts).
All interactive and key status components MUST include data-testid attributes.
No hover-only essential actions; ensure tap targets are min 44px for thumb accessibility.
Ensure non-transparent headers and bottom drawers (always use background color with blur).
